base_member_text: [L796] (MED/exclude/path) EXCLUDE is set to the bare relative name `variables.f90` while the INPUT directory is elsewhere; under the documented doxygen path rules this may not exclude the intended source file.
audit_member_text: [L761,L793-L796] (MED/documentation-exclusion) EXCLUDE names variables.f90 relative to the invocation directory while INPUT points three levels away, so the intended source-file exclusion does not identify the file in the input directory.

base_member_text: [L61,L761] (MED/path/working-directory) OUTPUT_DIRECTORY and INPUT are relative paths whose base is the directory from which doxygen is started, so using this config outside the companion bin-directory launch context silently changes or breaks the source/output locations.

[L412,L717] (LOW/configuration/inconsistency) EXTRACT_ALL=YES causes doxygen to disable undocumented-member warnings, so WARN_IF_UNDOCUMENTED=YES does not provide the warning behavior its setting suggests.

audit_member_text: [L41,L667] (LOW/documentation-provenance) Both project revision and file-version extraction are unset, leaving generated scientific code documentation without a source-version identifier.
